title: Role Acceleration Map and Hybrid Work Ops
author: Maya Patel
body:
Purpose
This handbook consolidates our expectations, checkpoints, and operational guidance for career progression and hybrid-first ways of working at Redwood. It’s intended for managers, ICs, and people-ops partners who are coaching career growth, onboarding new hires, or setting team norms.

Scope
Applies to all full-time employees, contractors on 6+ month engagements, and managers responsible for performance and career conversations. It complements role-specific competency maps and the promotion calibration process.

Core principles
- Growth is deliberate: career advancement at Redwood combines impact, scope, and demonstrated leadership (technical, operational, or cross-functional).
- Transparency: milestones, examples, and evidence types are shared openly to reduce ambiguity.
- Hybrid-first but flexible: we optimize for asynchronous collaboration while honoring team-level in-person norms.
- Tools-first enablement: we rely on a small set of canonical tools for access, documentation, and onboarding to reduce cognitive overhead.

Hybrid work operations (quick reference)
1) Default expectation: 3 days remote / 2 days in-office (subject to manager/team agreement).
2) Team norms checklist (teams must document in a short Confluence page linked from their team home):
   - Core collaboration hours (e.g., 10:00–15:00 local time)
   - Weekly in-person day(s) and purpose (planning, demos, onboarding)
   - Async-first runbooks for recurring tasks
3) Ad-hoc site access: submit a site reservation via People Portal at least 24 hours in advance for hot-desking.
4) Office expense allowances: see Benefits section below for stipend allocation and reimbursement process.

Role ladder summary (cross-functional template)
Use this template to align role expectations across Engineering, Product, Design, and Customer Success. Each level is defined by three axes: Impact (scope + outcomes), Craft (quality & depth of skill), and Leadership (influence, mentoring, cross-team coordination).

Levels (examples)
- IC1 / Associate: Demonstrates core proficiency; delivers tasks with direction; seeks feedback.
- IC2 / Mid: Owns features/projects end-to-end; mentors interns/juniors; contributes to team goals.
- IC3 / Senior: Leads cross-team initiatives; sets tech/product direction for medium areas; reliable independent operator.
- IC4 / Staff / Principal: Shapes multiple teams or a major product area; measured impact on company metrics; mentors managers and senior ICs.
- L6+ / Executive-distinguished: Strategy, org-level planning, and long-term roadmap ownership.

Promotion checkpoints (manager checklist)
1) Evidence collection: 6–10 artifacts with dates (PRs, design reviews, customer outcomes, incident postmortems, OKR results).
2) Feedback matrix: 360 feedback from peers, direct reports (if applicable), and cross-functional partners.
3) Impact memo: 1–2 page narrative written by candidate and reviewed by manager summarizing contributions, failures, and measurable outcomes.
4) Calibration packet: assembled by manager in People Portal and routed to the quarterly promotion committee.

30–60–90 onboarding plan (template for new hires)
- Day 0–7: Account access (Okta/SAML), essential tools (rwd CLI, Redwood Console), team intro, role objectives, first small task.
- Month 1: Deliver first production change or customer-facing artifact; complete at least two cross-team meetings; setup career goals in People Portal.
- Month 2: Lead a small project; present learnings at a team retro; begin mentorship pairing.
- Month 3: Hold a career check-in with manager and People Ops; define next quarter objectives and growth experiments.

Key internal tools (owners and quick guide)
- People Portal (people-ops): central place for role profiles, promotion packet submission, benefits enrollment, site reservations. Access: Onboarded via Okta group "People-Portal-Enabled".
- Redwood Console (product/eng): production metrics, model usage dashboards, route-level cost analytics. Owners: Eng Platform. Read-only for new hires until probation signoff.
- rwd CLI (engineering): developer CLI for local testing and service interaction. Install: pipx or brew; init with rwd auth. Quick command set provided in onboarding guide.
- Greenhouse (recruiting): interview scheduling, scorecards, and offer approvals. Recruiters own access provisioning.
- Confluence & Atlassian (docs): canonical documentation. Team owners maintain the team home page (link in People Portal).

Tools table (reference)
Name | Primary owner | When to request | Typical TTL
People Portal | People Ops | Onboarding day 0 | N/A
Redwood Console | Eng Platform | After 1 week (read-only) | Ongoing
rwd CLI | Dev Tools | Day 0 (devs) | Ongoing
Greenhouse | Recruiting | During interview loop | TTL per role
Okta | Security | First day | Ongoing

Hiring and interview guidance (for hiring managers)
- Role brief: publish a short role brief in Confluence using the role-brief template before sourcing. Must include success metrics, 6-month impact goals, and non-negotiables.
- Interview panels: balanced panels with at least one cross-functional interviewer and one hiring manager-level interviewer. Use standardized scorecards.
- Inclusion notes: proactively source diverse slates; flag potential bias with People Partners during debrief.
- Offer cadence: goal is 10 business days from first onsite to offer; exceptions require Recruiting director approval.

Benefits and perks (high level)
- Health & wellness: medical/dental/vision plans with company contribution; employee assistance program.
- Work-from-home stipend: $250/quarter for equipment and ergonomic needs. Reimbursement via People Portal with receipt upload.
- Learning budget: $1,200/year per employee for courses, conferences, and books. Approval in People Portal.
- Parental leave & returnship accommodations: see People Ops policy for details and pay schedules.

Manager playbook (first 90 days)
1) Hiring and ramp: complete manager onboarding checklist in People Portal; schedule 1:1s with each direct report weekly for first 30 days.
2) Career conversations: run discovery with each report to capture goals and a development plan in People Portal.
3) Performance calibration: prepare notes for the next retro and ensure performance expectations are explicit and documented.

Escalations and exceptions
- Confidential exceptions (salary, accommodations) are routed to People Ops with HRBP approval.
- Role scope conflicts: document overlapping responsibilities and escalate to functional leaders; temporary coordination owners should be appointed for 30–60 days.

Ownership and governance
- This document is owned by People Ops (Maya Patel).
- Review cadence: annual review in Q2 by People Ops with input from Eng Platform and Recruiting.
- Change procedure: propose updates via PR-style edits in Confluence and request reviewers listed above.

Appendix: promotion evidence examples
- PR link demonstrating ownership of major component
- Postmortem that reduced error budget by >= 30%
- Customer case study or measurable NPS improvement attributed to feature delivery
- Mentor/mentee outcomes with documented growth plan and results

Contact
For questions, file a People Ops request (People Portal) or email people-ops@redwood.ai.
